_comment: THE PIN TABLE. One place. Every model RichOS may download is listed here with the exact
byte count and the exact sha256 of the bytes we mean, plus where each hash came from.
A hash fetched from the same server it authenticates is not a check, so nothing in this
file is ever refreshed at run time. It is source. Changing a line here is a commit.
provenance is a LIST because agreement between independent witnesses is the whole value:
x-linked-etag   HuggingFace publishes the sha256 of every LFS file in this response header.
ceo-disk        shasum -a 256 over the CEO's own copy under ~/Models/Whisper.
wiki-record     a hash already written down in richos-hq wiki, recorded before this table.
A single-witness pin is honest but weaker; the field says which so nobody has to guess.
Read by lib/model-catalog.js and by tools/richos-hud/fetch-dictation-models.sh. The test
suite asserts those two readers agree, so the shell copy can never drift from this file.

models.note: Smallest English model. Not used by any shipping capability; pinned so an offer can exist.
The bundle-a-small-model candidate. Accuracy never measured on this project.
Quantized small.en. A low-disk fallback; not a shipping default.
Voice conversation + the Faster dictation mode. Three independent witnesses agree.
The More accurate dictation mode (quantized tier).
config.js DEFAULT_MODEL — call transcription. The largest thing RichOS ever downloads.
